main_interface.description: Main app window with header, tab content, sidebar, log panel

FB_LIST.interaction: left-click (select), double-click (open), right-click (context menu), checkbox (bulk select)

image_tab.description: Image generation tab with prompt, parameters, and action bar

INPUT_SUBJECT_REF.placeholder: Path or URL to character image

BTN_SEND_PIPELINE.state: disabled until generation completes; armed on success; consumed on click

CB_UPSCALE.interaction: checkbox toggles; label click opens settings

music_tab.description: Music generation tab with extensive parameters

step1.title: Step 1 · Get the AI instruction file

BTN_SAVE_INSTRUCTION.effect: opens Save-As dialog for the instruction manual

step2.title: Step 2 · Import the completed batch file

step3.title: Step 3 · Generate with M3 (no external AI)

CB_M3_TOGGLE.visual_anchor: Let the tool generate the batch using MiniMax M3 directly

paste_from_clipboard.trigger: Ctrl+V while pipeline overlay is open
paste_from_clipboard.effect: pasted images written to workspace/original/ and enqueued

BTN_LOAD_FOLDER.tooltip: Set the output folder for the whole pipeline

SUMMARY.visual_anchor: N images · N in Upscale · N running · N error

BTN_FINAL_COLUMN.tooltip: Clear or export the finalized images

LAST_CROP_LABEL.visible_when: crop column + previous crop this session

options.effect: copy to folder + remove from board

image_editor.trigger: BTN_IMAGE_EDIT / ✏ in image viewer / context menu → ✏ Edit
image_editor.layout: 3-pane: left tool rail, center canvas, right Asset Composer

canvas.interaction: Fabric.js canvas, drawing/objects, undo/redo (Ctrl+Z/Y), right-click context menu

objects_list.interaction: click row selects object on canvas; active row highlighted

queue_bar.interaction: click thumbnail switches active editing slot; shows modified indicator

resize_canvas_section.title: 📐 Resize canvas
resize_canvas_section.behavior: Lanczos3 resampling; >120% enlargement offers Real-ESRGAN upscale instead; pushes undo step

generate_popover.note: Uses same mmx contract as Image tab. For --n > 1, shows 2×2 picker modal to choose result.

options.desc: Fill a selected rectangle from surrounding texture (fast, local)
Fill all transparent holes left by background removal
Check status, replace MI-GAN / LaMa with newer ONNX

image_viewer_overlay.trigger: click thumbnail in preview / pipeline card thumbnail / fb-list double-click image

BTN_EDIT.tooltip: Edit this image in the pixel editor

content.interaction: Ctrl+wheel zooms, right-click opens save menu

image_viewer_overlay.navigation: Arrow keys wrap-around, nav list from preview batch or fb image files

audio_cutter.trigger: context menu → ✂ Audio cut… / bulk toolbar ✂ Trim
audio_cutter.title: ✂ Audio cut

WAVEFORM_STAGE.interaction: drag to set selection, drag markers

active_jobs_widget.trigger: automatic when generation jobs are running

elements.interaction: click row scrolls log to corresponding entry

generation_error_panel.location: status bar (top of content area) + toast + log entry
generation_error_panel.note: F4/F5 redesign: errors route to the status bar (class .error) with inline action links + toast + log. No per-tab preview area.

crop_overlay.trigger: context menu → ✂ Crop / pipeline card ✂ Drag frame

tab_eta_timer.behavior: estimates remaining time from rolling average; includes batch queue items

tab_intro_popup.trigger: first visit to each tab (gated by popup policy)
tab_intro_popup.title: 👋 Welcome to the <Tab> tab
tab_intro_popup.note: Deferred while startup popup chain is active

whats_new_toast.trigger: first launch of a new version (package.json version > lastSeenVersion)

batch_controls_bar.BTN_BATGEN_ALL_visible_when: total batch items across all tabs > 0

batch_entry_params.location: per-entry in BatchGen dialog (object entries only)
batch_entry_params.behavior: editing params revalidates; valid values clear ⚠ flag

all_batch_dashboard.trigger: BTN_BATGEN_ALL_EDIT (✎ next to BatGen All Types)
all_batch_dashboard.title: BatchGen Dashboard

optional_addons_popup.trigger: first-run auto-open / Settings → Image upscaling → Re-open add-ons
optional_addons_popup.title: 🧩 Optional add-ons

style_preview_block.location: below style dropdown on each tab
style_preview_block.content: Full prompt with style prefix highlighted (.prefix class)

lastcmd_tooltip.behavior: shows full ellipsized text; text-selectable; dismisses on click/scroll/resize
lastcmd_tooltip.note: LEGACY: .lastcmd spans were removed in H3-B9; tooltip component exists but has no active targets in current UI
